# Oventric

> Oventric is a builder-first tech platform combining a social feed, multi-vendor marketplace, academy, bounty board and a multi-currency escrow wallet.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Feed, marketplace, academy, bounties and wallet in one place.
- [About](/about): Our story and what Oventric is building.
- [FAQ](/faq): Accounts, marketplace escrow, wallet, payouts and bounties.
- [Help center](/help): Guides for accounts, payments and selling.
- [Help board](/help-board): Disputes, feedback and live support.
- [Advertise](/advertise): Ad tiers and targeting across Africa.
- [Affiliate](/affiliate): Referral program details.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Oventric collects and protects data.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms governing use of Oventric.
